title: OpenAI says GPT-5.5 Instant produces 52.5% fewer hallucinated claims "on high-stakes prompts covering areas like medicine, law, and finance" (Megan Morrone/Axios)
summary: Megan Morrone / Axios: OpenAI says GPT-5.5 Instant produces 52.5% fewer hallucinated claims “on high-stakes prompts covering areas like medicine, law, and finance” — - GPT-5.5 Instant is rolling out to all ChatGPT users and to the API. — Enhanced personalization is initially for Plus and Pro on the web.
contentText:
Megan Morrone / Axios :

OpenAI says GPT-5.5 Instant produces 52.5% fewer hallucinated claims “on high-stakes prompts covering areas like medicine, law, and finance”   —  - GPT-5.5 Instant is rolling out to all ChatGPT users and to the API.  —  Enhanced personalization is initially for Plus and Pro on the web.
